guard_changes.summary: Protected layout gate uses authenticated status. Password reset check remains supplemental and does not block when user is not hydrated.
Dashboard gate uses authenticated status only.
Authenticated users are redirected away from login without clearing auth state.
Capability bootstrap no longer requires a hydrated user object; authenticated token-only state uses a token-authenticated key.
When capability or module access state is loading or unknown, authenticated users are allowed through instead of being blocked by permission/module bootstrap.

non_blocking_background_modules.permissions: lazy/non-blocking; failure does not affect auth state
non_blocking_background_modules.approvals: lazy/non-blocking; failure does not affect auth state
non_blocking_background_modules.modules: lazy/non-blocking; loading/unknown state does not block authenticated routing
non_blocking_background_modules.users: lazy/non-blocking; user hydration is not an auth gate

not_run.reason: This step was constrained to frontend auth state machine and guards; previous DB-backed auth tests are blocked in this sandbox by unresolved PostgreSQL host db.
